name: BTC/USD Long-Short on US 10Y Yield Changes
description: Long/short BTC strategy based on US 10-year Treasury yield momentum. Goes long BTC when yields are falling (negative 10-day ROC) and short BTC when yields are rising (positive 10-day ROC), with automatic reversals on signal flips.
source:
# BTC/USD Long-Short on US 10Y Yield Changes
# Long when yields falling (ROC < 0), Short when yields rising (ROC > 0)

# Market data source for BTC
src = market_data_source(timeframe=4H)()
close = src.c

# Load US 10-Year Treasury yield data
yield_data = common_economic_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.Treasury10Y)()
yield_value = yield_data.result

# Forward-fill yield data to align with 4H bars
yield_filled = ffill(yield_value)

# Calculate 10-day rate of change on yield
# Note: At 4H timeframe, 10 days = 60 bars (6 bars per day * 10 days)
yield_roc = roc(period=60)(yield_filled)

# Entry signals based on yield momentum
# Long when yields falling (negative ROC)
long_signal = yield_roc < 0

# Short when yields rising (positive ROC)
short_signal = yield_roc > 0

# Long and short zones with automatic reversals
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=long_signal, short_entry=short_signal)

# Position sizing - 100% allocation
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=100)

# Visualization - Yield ROC
timeseries_lines(
    title="US 10Y Yield ROC (10-day)",
    category="Indicators",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Yield ROC", color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title="Zero Line", color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(yield_roc)

# Visualization - Filled Yield
timeseries_lines(
    title="US 10Y Treasury Yield (Forward-Filled)",
    category="Indicators",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="10Y Yield", color=Color.Amber)
    ])
)(yield_filled)
